children: Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp. reported results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, recording a net loss of $19.74K for the three months and a net loss of $84.02K for the six months; diluted loss per share was $(0.01) for the quarter and $(0.03) for the six-month period.
Net income: $(19,738) for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (net loss); $(84,023) for the six months ended June 30, 2026 (net loss).
Diluted earnings per share: $(0.01) for the three months ended June 30, 2026; $(0.03) for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
Operates as a blank-check special purpose acquisition company seeking an initial business combination across industries and regions.

Since inception activities have been limited to formation, completing an IPO and a concurrent private placement, and searching for an acquisition target; the company has commenced public-company compliance and diligence activities.
Approximately $115M of IPO proceeds have been placed in trust for use in a future acquisition; remaining funds have been used for the search and for operating expenses.
Company expects elevated public-company costs and continued diligence spending; it faces the risk of liquidation if it does not complete a business combination by July 22, 2027.
